name: Stationeers
description: Hard-science space station engineering and survival. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: Default game port 27016; change it in the server settings file or with launch options.

notes: Configure the server (name, password, save) via the settings file created on first run (setting.xml / default.ini in the server directory) or with launch options such as -loadlatest <savename> <worldtype> appended to the start command. Windows hosts: set the start command override to rocketstation_DedicatedServer.exe -batchmode -nographics.
